scope: Targeted nearest-prior-art review of information availability, observation selection, multimodal survival, staged horizons and generated measurements; not an exhaustive priority search.

sources.title: Leakage in Data Mining: Formulation, Detection, and Avoidance
sources.primary_source: Original conference paper hosted by a university
sources.comparison: Sections 2-4 already cover missing diagnosis-code patterns, downstream processing, prediction-time observability and learn-predict separation. The generic missingness-leakage mechanism is established.

sources.title: Recurrent Neural Networks for Multivariate Time Series with Missing Values
sources.comparison: GRU-D models observation masks and intervals as predictive information. Informative missingness can be admissible; association alone does not establish leakage.

sources.title: On the Nature of Informative Presence Bias in Analyses of Electronic Health Records
sources.primary_source: Original article abstract and publisher links indexed by PubMed
sources.comparison: Observation opportunities can induce differential misclassification. A related mechanism, not automatic proof of the same causal structure in this platform.

sources.title: Immortal time bias in pharmaco-epidemiology
sources.primary_source: Original article abstract and publisher links indexed by PubMed
sources.comparison: Immortal time concerns an outcome-impossible period induced by exposure or cohort definitions. Calendar-dependent feature coverage alone does not establish this condition.

sources.title: Forward and backward recurrence times and length biased sampling: age specific models
sources.primary_source: Original article abstract and publisher links indexed by PubMed
sources.comparison: Prevalent sampling and recurrence-time selection differ from an event-date-window cohort; length-proportional inclusion cannot be assumed without the relevant sampling law.

sources.title: Pitfalls of Administrative Censoring in Survival Models with Time-Indexed Inputs
sources.comparison: Reference-date clues plus a shared study endpoint create censoring-related shortcuts. The present event-date-conditioned coverage identity has a different selection predicate; broader observation-design arguments overlap.

sources.title: Temporal Databases
sources.comparison: Valid time and transaction time are established database concepts; adding a knowledge-time axis is not a new principle.

sources.title: reproducible historical feature queries (#2980)
sources.comparison: Proposes a global created-time cutoff to make historical retrieval robust to late or restated records; predates the present implementation.

sources.title: feat: Opt-in created_timestamp <= entity_timestamp cutoff in point-in-time joins (as-of-known-time retrieval) (#6615)
sources.comparison: Distinguishes event-time filtering from per-row known-time retrieval.

sources.title: feat: Add opt-in filter_by_created_timestamp cutoff to get_historical_features (#6617)
sources.comparison: Implements an opt-in known-time predicate. Predating this merge would not prove priority over established temporal database or leakage principles.

sources.title: Multimodal Co-Attention Transformer for Survival Prediction in Gigapixel Whole Slide Images
sources.comparison: Direct prior work for attention-based multimodal survival modeling.

sources.title: MoME: Mixture of Multimodal Experts for Cancer Survival Prediction
sources.comparison: Progressive fusion and multimodal expert selection are established. The specific trained system and policy must carry the present contribution.

sources.title: Perceiver: General Perception with Iterative Attention
sources.comparison: Latent attention over heterogeneous inputs is prior art.

sources.title: WRSE - a non-parametric weighted-resolution ensemble for predicting individual survival distributions in the ICU
sources.comparison: Combines horizon-specific classifiers with resolution emphasizing near-term prediction; differs from ordered rejection gates but precedes broad multi-horizon ensemble claims.

sources.title: Concept Bottleneck Models
sources.comparison: Predicting interpretable concepts before outcomes and intervening on them is established. Parallel feature branches do not form a strict concept bottleneck.

sources.title: Multimodal Survival Modeling in the Age of Foundation Models
sources.date_type: First preprint submission; version 1 reviewed; later version has a changed title
sources.comparison: Frozen multimodal representations, classical survival models, generated report summarization and hallucination interventions provide a close pre-existing comparison.
